claim: Counterpoint Research estimated TSMC's share of the pure-play foundry market at 73% in Q2 2026 (Samsung Foundry 7%, SMIC 5%, UMC 4%, GlobalFoundries 3%), with the pure-play foundry market up 29% year on year.
evidence: Table 'Pure-Play Foundry Market Share in Q2 2026': "TSMC | 68% | 71% | 72% | 72% | 73% | 73%"; "the pure-play foundry market grew 29% year-on-year in the second quarter of 2026" (Counterpoint Research insight, Aug 2026)

metric.name: TSMC share of pure-play foundry market
metric.population: Pure-play foundry revenue as tracked by Counterpoint (Samsung Foundry included)
metric.methodology: Counterpoint Pure Foundry Market Share Tracker; method not disclosed

claim: Counterpoint Research put the Q2 2026 'Foundry 2.0' market (pure-play foundries, non-memory IDMs, OSATs and photomask makers) at US$96.6 billion, of which pure-play foundries were US$54.9 billion (57%) and OSATs US$12.6 billion, as reported by Chosun Biz.
evidence: "second-quarter global \"Foundry 2.0\" market revenue was $96.6 billion, up 25% from a year earlier"; "Second-quarter revenue for pure-play foundries was $54.9 billion ... metric.name: Foundry 2.0 market revenue (Counterpoint)
metric.population: Pure-play foundries + non-memory IDMs + OSATs + photomask makers (Counterpoint Foundry 2.0 definition)
metric.methodology: Counterpoint foundry market supply tracker, relayed by press

claim: Counterpoint Research estimated TSMC at 42% of the Foundry 2.0 market in Q2 2026 (TSMC revenue US$40.2 billion), up from 38% a year earlier, as reported by Chosun Biz.
evidence: "TSMC's revenue was $40.2 billion (about 54.34 trillion won), up 34% from a year earlier and 12% from the previous quarter. TSMC's share of the overall Foundry 2.0 market also expanded to 42% in the second quarter from 38% a year earlier." (Chosun Biz, 30 Sep 2026)

metric.name: TSMC share of Foundry 2.0 market
metric.population: Counterpoint Foundry 2.0 market (foundry + non-memory IDM + OSAT + photomask)

claim: Nikkei's 2025 market-share survey put Shin-Etsu Chemical at 26.3% and SUMCO at 17.8% of the global silicon wafer market (44.1% combined), with the 3rd-5th ranked makers (from Taiwan, Germany and South Korea) at 31.9% combined.
evidence: "Shin-Etsu Chemical takes the first place with a 26.3% market share ... SUMCO ranks second with a 17.8% share ... The combined share of the two enterprises rose by 2.8 percentage points to 44.1% ... the 3rd to 5th ranked enterprises ... combined market share dropped by 0.7 percentage points to 31.9%." (36Kr/Nikkei Chinese Net, 31 Jul 2026)

metric.name: Shin-Etsu plus SUMCO share of silicon wafer market
metric.population: Silicon wafer market (Nikkei survey basis; revenue vs volume not stated in the relay)
metric.methodology: Nikkei 'Survey on Market Shares of Major Goods and Services'; method not given in the relay

claim: TrendForce estimated (June 2026) that HBM takes about 18% of the top three DRAM makers' total DRAM wafer input at end-2025 (22% at end-2026, 30% at end-2027) but only about 8% of DRAM bit supply (9% and 13%).
evidence: "TrendForce estimates that HBM wafer input among the top three suppliers will account for approximately 18%, 22%, and 30% of total DRAM wafer input by the end of 2025, 2026, and 2027, respectively. Meanwhile, HBM bit supply is expected to represent approximately 8%, 9%, and 13% of total DRAM bit supply during the same period." (TrendForce, 2 Jun 2026)

metric.name: HBM share of DRAM wafer input
metric.population: Top three DRAM suppliers (Samsung, SK hynix, Micron) wafer input

claim: SIA/BCG's 2024 report (Exhibit 2) gives 2022 semiconductor value added by activity as EDA and core IP 3%, logic design 30%, DAO (discretes, analog, optoelectronics) design 17%, memory design 9%, manufacturing equipment 12%, materials 5%, wafer fabrication 19% and ATP 6%, so chip design in total was about 56%.
evidence: paraphrase of chart text: Exhibit 2 'Semiconductor industry value-added by activity and region, 2022 (%)' labels read "EDA & Core IP 3% Logic 30% ... DAO 17% Memory 9% Mfg equipment 12% Materials 5% Wafer fabrication 19% ATP 6%" (SIA/BCG, Emerging Resilience, May 2024, p.11). Design = 30+17+9 = 56% (our sum; all shares sum to 101% by rounding).

metric.name: Design share of industry value added (logic + DAO + memory design)
metric.population: Semiconductor industry value added by activity (SIA/BCG)
metric.methodology: BCG analysis of IPnest, Wolfe Research, Gartner and SEMI data; design shares summed by us

notes: Chart text extracted from the PDF; the activity labels sit next to their values. Compare CLM-2376 (2019 data, 2021 report: design 50%).
